title: Oh my soul
lyrics_original: Oh, how you're weary from fearing
And no one would blame you though
If you tried to hide it away
Has to face the God you know
That someday it all works out
There will be beauty where beauty was
Has to face the God you know
Will never get me to shore
Can he keep me from going under?
Has to face the God you know

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, నీవేల క్రుంగియున్నావు?  నాలో నీవేల తొందరపడుచున్నావు? దేవునియందు నిరీక్షణ యుంచుము, ఆయనే నా రక్షణకర్త నా దేవుడు ఇంకను నేనాయనను స్తుతించెదను.
bible_verses.english: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రయాసపడి  భారము మోసికొనుచున్న సమస్త జను    లారా, నా యొద్దకు రండి; నేను మీకు విశ్రాంతి కలుగ జేతును.
bible_verses.english: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

bible_verses.telugu: దేనినిగూర్చియు చింతపడకుడి గాని ప్రతి విషయములోను ప్రార్థన విజ్ఞాపనములచేత కృతజ్ఞతాపూర్వకముగా మీ విన్నపములు దేవునికి తెలియజేయుడి. అప్పుడు సమస్త జ్ఞానమునకు మించిన  దేవుని సమాధానము యేసుక్రీస్తువలన మీ హృదయములకును మీ తలంపులకును కావలి యుండును.
bible_verses.english: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, my soul feels weary, and the weight of what I cannot control feels overwhelming today. Forgive me for trying to hide my fear and carry this burden all by myself. I bring my honest tears and trembling heart to You, trusting in Your promise of rest. Please quiet my anxious thoughts with Your gentle peace and remind me that my life is safe in Your loving hands. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, my soul feels weary, and the weight of what I cannot control feels overwhelming today. Forgive me for trying to hide my fear and carry this burden all by myself. I bring my honest tears and trembling heart to You, trusting in Your promise of rest. Please quiet my anxious thoughts with Your gentle peace and remind me that my life is safe in Your loving hands. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When unexpected storms shatter our sense of control, it is easy for worry and weariness to take root deep within our souls. We often feel pressured to hide our tears and put on a brave face, even when our faith feels fragile. Yet, Jesus warmly invites us to bring our honest pain, quiet doubts, and heaviest burdens directly to Him. You do not have to carry this alone or pretend to be strong; Christ is your safe refuge, gently anchoring your heart in His peace.
